title: Well-formed phased migration — correct NOT VALID + CONCURRENTLY + backfill pattern
expected_feedback: No violations. Correctly implements phased migration: (1) add nullable column inside a transaction with SET LOCAL lock_timeout, (2) keyset backfill, (3) idempotent CHECK with NOT VALID guarded by a conrelid-scoped pg_constraint lookup, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT (non-blocking), (4) SET NOT NULL which PG 12+ satisfies from the CHECK without a full scan, then drop the now-redundant CHECK. Every guard is in the form that matches its execution context. The idempotency guard reads pg_get_constraintdef() rather than deciding on the constraint name alone, so a same-named constraint with a different definition raises instead of silently skipping the migration.
